::: saline-secao
## Who is Saline Astral

Saline Astral was born from a question: what if the patterns I learned to see in data also existed within us?

Behind this project is a statistician and Master's student in Business Administration who found in analytical rigor another way of looking inward. Here, Jung, affective neuroscience and art talk without hurry. There is no promise of healing and no formula for motivation. There is an invitation to know yourself, including the parts you learned to hide.
:::

::: saline-secao
## Music

Saline Astral's songs exist in Portuguese, Spanish, English, French and German, because what we feel inside does not fit into a single language.

[Course]{.saline-rotulo}

## Integração com as Sombras (Integrating the Shadow)

Thirteen lessons on the shadow, the central concept of Carl Jung's analytical psychology, supported by affective neuroscience and concrete integration practices. Free, on YouTube, at your own pace. Course in Portuguese.

Integrating the shadow is not about becoming a better person. It is about becoming more whole than you already are.

[Watch on YouTube](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcpxt7S-mEbA&si=k8LiBhqYD8lvdJVk){.btn .saline-botao}
